tool_limitations.limitation: All no-registration failures were labeled unavailable even when winapp explicitly reported an invalid manifest.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Classify manifest schema errors as a hard migration failure while keeping genuine developer-mode, framework, certificate, and path failures inconclusive.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and final build instructions
doc_errors.correct: Use native dotnet build against the target csproj; winapp provides run but not build in this environment.

doc_errors.wrong: The checklist said to add runFullTrust and retain custom/device capabilities without stating the schema-required child order.
doc_errors.correct: Place rescap:Capability entries before CustomCapability entries, and place DeviceCapability entries last.

special_apis.special_handling: AppX capability child groups are order-sensitive. runFullTrust must precede custom and device capabilities or package registration fails despite a clean build.
The sample requires a custom capability/SCCD and a visible fallback when the machine does not support hotspot acquisition.

errors_encountered.error: Test-Path returned False immediately after bootstrap launch.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Bootstrap and self-check were invoked in parallel instead of as the skill's ordered commands.
errors_encountered.fix: Wait for bootstrap completion, then rerun Test-Path; it returned True.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill prescribed a command absent from the installed winapp CLI.
errors_encountered.fix: Use dotnet build/dotnet run against the csproj.

errors_encountered.error: dotnet run could not find a project.
errors_encountered.root_cause: It was run from the parent app directory while the scaffolded csproj was nested one level below.
errors_encountered.fix: Pass --project with the absolute csproj path.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent explicitly included .cs files already covered by SDK default item globs.

errors_encountered.error: WMC9999 could not find linked Scenario1_ManageHotspot.xaml.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Brittle relative links to sibling shared content were resolved from an unexpected build location.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent tried absolute linking, then ultimately created a local target XAML file.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061 InitializeComponent missing, CS0103 named controls missing, and CS0246 MainWindow missing.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Linked XAML did not generate the expected partial class and the scaffold MainWindow was deleted while App still referenced it.
errors_encountered.fix: Create a coherent local XAML/code-behind pair and host the root Frame directly in Window.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Legacy BackgroundTask\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs was compiled together with SDK-generated assembly metadata.
errors_encountered.fix: The trial disabled generated assembly info; the general fix is for bootstrap not to copy legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs.

errors_encountered.root_cause: rescap:Capability runFullTrust was appended after uap4:CustomCapability, violating the Capabilities schema sequence.
errors_encountered.fix: Move runFullTrust before custom/device capabilities and treat explicit manifest schema rejection as a hard validator failure.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Three successive project-file link approaches produced NETSDK1022, two WMC9999 path errors, then missing generated partial-class members.

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The agent linked external shared XAML instead of copying it verbatim into the target and keeping the XAML/code-behind pair local.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: It authored a local XAML file and removed the external Page link.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Follow the existing fidelity rule to copy source XAML verbatim; do not regenerate it or use machine-specific absolute links.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent saw an explicit AppX schema validation error but declared the migration complete because the validator labeled it an environment warning.

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The validator collapsed every no-registration result into unavailable and did not check capability ordering.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in the migration trial; scoring recorded runs=false and score 0.
